FAL 50.00.description:
A Belvaunian battle rifle that has rightfully earned the moniker of 'the right arm of the free world'.
Fires quickly with moderate recoil while being very powerful, but suffers from a slow reload!

Model submitted by Rialag!
FAL 50.00.name: FAL 50.00

G3.description:
An Eisenmarkian Cold War Classic, outfitted with a roller-delayed blowback system. It compensates its high recoil and lower rate of fire by handsomely rewarding accurate shots to the head while still punishing poor aiming with its rather mediocre reload speed.

When I go home, they will ask me why I did it or I am some war junkie. You know what I will say? Not a single word.
G3.name: G3

MCX SPEAR.description:
Adopted as the new assault rifle of the Grand Federation, the winner of their next generation competition chosen to replace their standard issue carbine. It fires a high pressure 6.8x51mm round designed to improve upon 7.62x51mm NATO with better recoil control, ballistics, and penetration.

Somewhat lower damage, but makes up for it with a very high rate of fire and acceptable recoil control.

Community submitted model!
MCX SPEAR.name: MCX SPEAR

AK-308.description:
A Zarovian export battle rifle chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO that was developed in tandem with the AK-12 family of rifles, though the earliest prototypes were based on the AK-100 platform.

Lower than average damage, but above average handling characteristics.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
AK-308.name: AK-308

FAL 50.63 PARA.description:
A paratrooper variant of the FAL 50.00.
While not as powerful as other battle rifles, it is quite lightweight. Strong recoil, high velocity and a decently fast reload.

Model submitted by Rialag!
FAL 50.63 PARA.name: FAL 50.63 PARA

attachmentModifiers.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better equip, aim, walkspeed, and recoil recovery speed.
Accuracy is hindered from the lack of a stock.

HENRY 45-70.description: A modern take on the classic lever-action rifle, firing the heavyweight .45-70 Government round. 5-round tube, slow muzzle velocity, but instantly kills to the head.
HENRY 45-70.name: HENRY 45-70

BREN 2 BR.description:
A Korvan Republika battle rifle developed from the VZ.806 which uses an atypical 25-round magazines.

Extremely high rate of fire with high recoil.
Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
BREN 2 BR.name: BREN 2 BR

AG-3.description: A Valkarian take on the STG-59H, featuring more modularity and special modifications to specalize in the defense of Valkar. High firerate with powerful but predictable recoil.
AG-3.name: AG-3

SHAK-12.description:
The SHAK12, originally called the ASH12, is a Zarovian bullpup battle rifle chambered for the 12.7x55mm STS-130 cartridge designed to combine high stopping power with relatively limited penetration to avoid collateral damage in urban combat.While it shares a lot of design similarities with the VKS sniper rifle, the two do not use interchangeable ammunition.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
SHAK-12.name: SHAK-12
